name: Geometric Self-Intersection Elimination
definition: A geometric treatment applied when connecting dual vertices in an adaptive octree construction to eliminate self-intersections in the resulting surface. It involves checking for ambiguous faces and creating triangle fans instead of trivial triangulations when necessary.
summary: Geometric Self-Intersection Elimination is a post-processing technique for adaptive octrees that replaces ambiguous dual triangulations with triangle fans to guarantee intersection-free surfaces, explicitly increasing mesh complexity unlike regular ambiguity treatments.
